core_corrections: Complete checkpoint and index custody prevent deleted acknowledged files from being interpreted as new capture permission, including after restart.
Retained ancestor, root, index and original descriptors fence physical replacements, aliases, hard links and changed bytes. Failed reads and cancellation precede equality and byte-count comparisons.
Publication preserves uncertain pending original bytes; no live recapture occurs after a mutation failure.
Transient incomplete cuts consume no immutable outbox phase; the same signed permission may capture only after actual pending callback completion.
Pure borrowed-read restore API has no SN or durablevolume import in the SDK parent and returns explicit physical index bytes for copied inodes.
Inventory registers only the exact SDK and validator.requests.v1 attributes at 4096 bytes each; nearby unknown names remain refused.
Physical metadata preparation admits existing immutable 0400 original members while requiring its unsigned index to remain 0600.
